input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) imposes a one-way non-solicit on us (Licensee) that runs for the Term plus three years and covers any person employed by Licensor or any of its Affiliates. That hits two walk-away triggers under NOSOLICIT: a restriction longer than 24 months and coverage of all Vendor personnel rather than only those involved in the services. The clause does contain an adequate general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out and no no-hire element, but those points do not cure the duration and scope failures. Per the redline guidance we narrowed to the fallback with minimal edits: mutual, twelve months post-termination, limited to personnel directly involved in performance, leaving the existing carve-out sentence intact. Note that Article XI also grants Licensor injunctive relief for breach of the non-solicit, which becomes correspondingly narrower once this edit is accepted.

proposal.summary: Make the non-solicit mutual, cut the tail from three years to twelve months, and limit it to personnel directly involved in this Agreement.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed this non-solicit to our fallback position: mutual, twelve months post-termination, and limited to personnel who were directly involved in performing this Agreement, retaining the existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs. A three-year restriction covering every Licensor and Affiliate employee is far broader than we can accept.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement to leave his or her employment with that party.
